name: bielu-bettersearch
description: Placeholder package representing the shared version of every Bielu.BetterSearch NuGet package. Bump this in a changeset for any NuGet change; scripts/apply-nuget-version.mjs projects its version onto version.props. Not published anywhere. The repository is in changesets pre mode (.changeset/pre.json) so releases stay on the beta line until ROADMAP.md says it is ready to exit.
